New Foldable iPhone Scam: Don’t Click on That Preorder Link: problems: safeMove.say states as plain fact that 'Phones with up-to-date software are protected from this.' The source attributes this to Apple ('Apple says...'). It also covers only the reported DarkSword attacks on iPhones, not the page as a whole. Dropping the attribution and widening it to 'this' overstates the guarantee. Keep the 'Apple says' framing or soften the wording. (rewrite 2 of 2)
